title: Machine learning and experiments yield tolerant polymer dielectrics
summary: An informatics screen of over 13,000 known polymers, combined with phenomenological models, selected representative dielectric candidates for experimental testing. Two of the proposed polymers were synthesized and reported as tolerant to field and temperature extremes. The validation set is very small, and the exact property values were not verified in this search.
ai_technology: Machine learning and informatics models for polymer dielectric screening

evidence.tested: Machine-learning models screened more than 13,000 synthesized polymers, and some screened candidates received experimental breakdown-strength validation.
evidence.unknown: The abstract says discovery of suitable candidates is nontrivial, not all predicted candidates were tested, and limits of the ML models are not described.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning models of dielectric properties screened the polymer candidate list.
